description:
Signed station-health row for a settlement station; see /docs

Live is paid, history is free. The live answer is a flat price via
x402 when the answer is fresh. Every paid live answer is a signed row
that also appears in the next UTC day's public file
(`v1/health/<D>.jsonl` on the weather relay, searchable via
`ledger_search` with `source=weather-health`), so anyone can check a
paid answer for free the next day.

A stale answer is always free (`verdict: stale` with a `reason`),
including `live_token_missing` (the Worker has no live-relay token)
and `relay_403` (the relay refused the live read).

X-PAYMENT.description: base64(JSON) x402 payment. Only a fresh answer is ever charged, and only when the paid tools flag is on.

icao.description: ICAO code of a weather settlement station, case-insensitive. An unknown code answers 404 with the valid codes in `stations`.

receipt.description: When true, attach a signed Receipt v1.0 over the answer (not logged to the receipts ledger). A signing failure never costs you the answer.

name: station_health
